tests.goal: plus(a, zero) = a → plus(s(a), zero) = s(a)
len(app(l, nil)) = len(l) → len(app(cons(i, l), nil)) = s(len(l))

brief.zh: 设计一个证明助手，证完每一个目标。
brief.en: Design a proof assistant that proves every goal.

hint.en: The “if” half has to be among the givens first.

hint.zh: 化简的规则里有一条是「已知里的等式」。
hint.en: One of Simp’s rules is “an equation given”.

t.zh: 已知里的等式也能当改写规则，把左边换成右边。
t.en: An equation among the givens can be a rewrite rule too, its left side replaced by its right.
